d3b32f15-6fd7-40e3-be52-e083f51b19a2.name: Google 云端硬盘文件输入
d3b32f15-6fd7-40e3-be52-e083f51b19a2.source: Agent-level input for a Google Drive file. REQUIRED for any agent that reads or writes a Drive file (Sheets, Docs, Slides, or generic Drive) — the picker is the only source of the _credentials_id needed at runtime, so consuming blocks cannot receive a hardcoded ID. Set allowed_views to match the consumer: ["SPREADSHEETS"] for Sheets, ["DOCUMENTS"] for Docs, ["PRESENTATIONS"] for Slides (leave default for generic Drive). Wire `result` to the consumer block's Drive field and leave that field unset in the consumer's input_default. Example link to a Google Sheets block: {"source_name": "result", "sink_name": "spreadsheet"} (use "document" for Docs, "presentation" for Slides). Use one input block per distinct file; multiple consumers of the same file share it.
d3b32f15-6fd7-40e3-be52-e083f51b19a2.description: 读取或写入 Google 云端硬盘文件时必须使用此输入模块。只有文件选择器会附带运行时所需的 _credentials_id，不能直接向后续模块传入固定文件 ID。为 allowed_views 指定文件类型：表格用 ["SPREADSHEETS"]，文档用 ["DOCUMENTS"]，演示文稿用 ["PRESENTATIONS"]；通用文件保留默认值。将 result 连到使用该文件的模块，并在其 input_default 中留空对应字段。例如表格的连线是 {"source_name": "result", "sink_name": "spreadsheet"}，文档和演示文稿分别使用 document 和 presentation。每个不同的文件需要一个输入模块；同一文件可供多个模块共用。

f8a12c8d-3e4b-4d5f-b6a7-8c9d0e1f2g3h.name: Slant 3D · 模型切片
f8a12c8d-3e4b-4d5f-b6a7-8c9d0e1f2g3h.source: Get a live 3D printing quote for physical parts from STL URLs or attached workspace files. Use this to price printable parts and complete project part sets before ordering from Slant3D, which manufactures and ships the parts. Binary STL URLs are accepted directly; no browser upload is needed. For complete projects, first read the assembly bill of materials: include repeated parts across subassemblies, select a design variant for alternative parts while keeping the required number of copies, and exclude reference assembly meshes. One copy of each STL is not necessarily a complete set. Quote each required file with its full assembly quantity and sum the returned prices, which already include quantity. Before reporting a complete quote, reconcile all quoted files and quantities against the parts list. Printing-only quotes need no shipping address or payment method. Returns a reusable file_id for ordering; this block does not place or charge an order.
f8a12c8d-3e4b-4d5f-b6a7-8c9d0e1f2g3h.description: 根据 STL URL 或工作区文件实时查询 3D 打印价格，无需配送地址或支付方式。二进制 STL 可直接通过 URL 提交。为整套项目询价前须核对装配清单：计入重复件，备选零件只选定一种方案并保留所需数量，排除仅供参考的装配网格。逐个文件按实际数量报价并汇总，返回价格已包含数量。返回的 file_id 可用于后续下单，本模块不会下单或扣款。
